text: MitosisEngine calibration defect — RESTORED after being closed by mistake (a 'ing done 1' meant for the corpus-blocker item closed this one instead; it is NOT fixed). split_threshold ships at 0.3 while measured tension peaks at 0.037 and the measurement-derived bar is 0.0397 — 7.6x too high; merge_threshold=0.05 sits above the inter-cell tension too, so the engine can only merge. Threshold-driven mitosis has never fired on any path in this repo (mitosis.demo()'s single MITOSIS line is a forced split_cell() call). QD-6 measured that fixing it forms a population (3.1 cells) but does not improve stimulus retention. Also open: MitosisC.__init__ force-grows by cloning cells[0], which merge_cells then deletes.
